tools.name: estimate_scrutiny_fee
tools.description: Estimates municipal building plan scrutiny fees (ZAR) in Gauteng based on total floor area (sqm), municipality, and SANS 10400 occupancy classification. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'estimate_scrutiny_fee' on Building Compliance Agency (buildingcompliance.co.za).

tools.name: check_zoning_requirements
tools.description: Retrieves typical municipal coverage, Floor Area Ratio (FAR), height, and parking requirements for a given Gauteng municipality and zoning category. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'check_zoning_requirements' on Building Compliance Agency (buildingcompliance.co.za).

tools.description: Submits a compliance consultation or quote request for council building plan approval, archive plan retrieval, occupancy certificates, fire clearance, SDP, or rezoning. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: estimate_scrutiny_fee, check_zoning_requirements · Private data: estimate_scrutiny_fee, check_zoning_requirements, submit_compliance_inquiry · Public sink: submit_compliance_inquiry · Destructive: estimate_scrutiny_fee, check_zoning_requirements, submit_compliance_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: estimate_scrutiny_fee, check_zoning_requirements · Private data: estimate_scrutiny_fee, check_zoning_requirements, submit_compliance_inquiry · Public sink: submit_compliance_inquiry · Destructive: estimate_scrutiny_fee, check_zoning_requirements, submit_compliance_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
